metadata.name: recursive-decision-ledger
metadata.description: Run repeated rollouts ("Prime Gauss" style recursive prompting) while keeping an append-only decision ledger of trials, marks, coherence checks, and promotion gates, so recursive confidence never auto-approves live trading, deploy, or destructive actions. Use when the user asks for repeated rollouts, marked decision processes, high-dimensional search, stochastic optimization, local-optima exploration, ensemble comparison, or recursive reasoning with a visible evidence trail.
metadata.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
